description: Replacement-family member: Adapt fixed at keyword-high, Jurebes (sklearn MLP classifier, the top-accuracy baseline on the intents-for-eval en-US template board) fills the template-medium slot.
notes: FAMILY: tmpl-slot 4-way — mycroft-classic (adapt-high -> padatious-medium) is the shared baseline; siblings are tmpl-slot-nebulento, tmpl-slot-linhafina, tmpl-slot-jurebes (this file), each swapping only the template-medium engine with adapt-high held fixed. There is no separate tmpl-slot-padatious fighter: that config is identical to mycroft-classic, and per the 1-fighter-per-config rule mycroft-classic itself serves as the 'template engine = padatious' cell of this grid rather than duplicating the same pipeline under a second competitor_id. This sibling swaps in Jurebes using the same top-accuracy 'mlp_shallow' baseline selected for trident.json (accuracy 0.8154 on frontend-static/public/data/benchmark-intent_template-intents-for-eval-en-US.json among all jurebes-* entries), with exact_match forced to false so the fighter tests the trained classifier itself rather than jurebes's own internal exact-template short-circuit — consistent with the exact_match:false convention used everywhere jurebes appears in this pass. adapt-high held fixed as the front door, matching the other tmpl-slot siblings.
